Left of the text is a strip from the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed. At the foot: the gathering signature at the left and the catchword "ad" at the right.

main_text.p: fiæ perdurantis in successione Apostolorum; Alteram, nouæ exorientis, in fraterculorum & Canonistarum nouis institutionibus, qui nullam habent vocationem, nec ius prædi- candi, nec successionem, sed lubito viden- tur post tempus solutionis Satanæ è terra pro- gnati, vel è puteo abyssi exorti, sine successio- ne ab Apostolis, sine authoritate ab Ecclesia, solius Romani Pontificis arbitrio instituti & confirmati.

Hæc autem fides, quamvis in Ecclesiæ gre- mio exoriens, non Ecclesia, sed, sicut doctis- simus vir Iohannes Feildius noster, S. Theo- logiæ Doctor, quem honoris & dignitatis causa nomino, obseruauit; Romanæ Ec- clesiæ factio tantummodo habenda est, si- ne Romana Curia. Interea Ecclesia Ro- mana vixit, durauitque, donec paulatim ab hac factione, siue Romana Curia supe- rata, ac tandem velut absorpta [?] videretur.

Itaque plurimos videmus viros doctos, pios- que, nonnunquam etiam Principes reli- giosos, quoties se à Romani Pontificis ty- rannide oppressos sentiebant, vel metue- bant, provocasse à Romano Pontifice, & Romana hac Curia, ad Romanam Eccle- siam.
Legimus in scriptis Guilielmi Occham, Michaelem Cezenam, quem Iohannes Pa- pa XXII[?]. Anno Christi millesimo trecente- simo octauo depofuit, appellasse ab iniusta apæ tyrannide, & à Romana Curia,

page.notes: The first printed word of the page, "fiæ", is a fragment carried over from the previous line and is kept as such. "absorpta" is hard to read at the line end, so it is marked [?]. The numeral "XXII" in the line "Papa XXII." is faded and marked [?]. The catchword "ad" is set at the right below the last line and is not in the text. The strip at the left edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The ink mark at the right edge of the text is not printed text and is omitted.
